events.name: Alien Invasion
events.when: Special events, and now and then outside them
events.summary: Aliens come through the realm in three waves, the Adept biomes first and the Veteran biomes after, until Commander Calbrik's UFO arrives. The waves come from the client; how many kills each takes is not published.

spawns.name: Alien Reactor
spawns.note: Stationary reactors stand in the biomes while the invasion runs; Calbrik's defeat makes them vulnerable.

spawns.name: Alien UFO
spawns.note: Appears once enough aliens have been killed and every wormhole has gone.

spawns.name: Commander Calbrik
spawns.note: The last fight of the invasion. Defeating him opens the reactors.

spawns.name: Alien Biff
spawns.note: Once a realm, after every Cyclops God is dead (the Alien Invasion 2 event).

spawns.name: Alien Leprechaun
spawns.note: Once a realm, after every Ghost King is dead (the Alien Invasion 2 event).

events.name: Halloween
events.summary: Three Halloween threats keep to the Haunted Hallows, each out at its own marks of the realm's score.

spawns.name: Totalia the Malevolent
spawns.note: A small blackened setpiece with a pile of bones. In Season 31 she also shows once in the Ship Wreck and once in the Dead Church.

spawns.name: Zombie Horde
spawns.note: Waves of zombies; their boss comes out once enough of them have been killed.

spawns.name: Bonegrind the Undead Butcher
spawns.note: The Zombie Horde's boss, out once a certain number of its minions are killed.

spawns.name: The Hemomancer's Henchman
spawns.note: Defeated three times, one for each mark, to bring out the Hemomancer.

spawns.name: The Hemomancer
spawns.note: Comes out after the third Henchman falls, the last of them at 86%.

events.name: Christmas
events.summary: Winter bosses that wait for the realm to fill.

spawns.name: Jotunn
spawns.note: Once a realm.

spawns.name: The Santappetizer
spawns.note: During special event periods in winter.

spawns.name: The Skeyper
spawns.note: Five towers rise at 33% and wake again at 66%; the Skeyper comes once they have all fallen.

events.name: Valentine's Day
events.when: Valentine's Day, and some other events
events.summary: Event bosses for the Adept biomes, brought out at a third and two thirds of the realm.

spawns.name: The Gardener
spawns.note: Marked with a quest marker when it spawns. It used to keep to the Sprite Forest and the Coral Reefs; the 2026 notes widen it to the Adept and Veteran biomes.

spawns.name: The Keyper
spawns.note: Five Crystal Towers rise in the Adept biomes at 33% and respawn their minions at 66%; the Keyper comes after all five have fallen.

spawns.name: The Appetizer
spawns.note: During special event periods.

events.name: Easter
events.summary: Biff comes out of Relentless Springs twice.

spawns.name: Biff the Buffed Bunny
spawns.note: As of Easter 2025.

events.name: Legend of the White Snake
events.summary: An altar in the Carboniferous that calls Primal Snakes as the realm fills.

spawns.name: Altar of the White Snake
spawns.note: Appears at 30% with three Primal Snakes; it can be used again at 50%. More Primal Snakes come at other marks the pages do not give.

events.name: Oryxmania
events.summary: Arena champions, with their way in brought out twice a realm.

spawns.name: Arena Announcer
spawns.note: Take part in the Rumble by fighting him; a portal leads to the first Arena.

spawns.name: The Keyper of the Arena
spawns.note: A reskin of the Keyper, out twice a realm.

events.name: Vindication
events.summary: The mercenaries come back to the realms.

spawns.name: The mercenaries
spawns.note: In the new realm, one at each tenth of the score. In the old realm they came after 8, 16, 24 and 32 Heroes of Oryx.

spawns.name: The Interregnum Portals
spawns.note: Two sets, in the new realm. In the old realm they came after the Red Demons and the Ghost Kings.

events.name: Blooming Oasis
events.summary: Harmless flowers bloom in the Adept biomes.

spawns.name: Blooming Flower Realm
spawns.note: Harmless, during the first half of the season.

spawns.name: Voided Blooming Flower
spawns.note: Harmless, during the second half of the season.

events.name: Heatwave
events.summary: Totems stand in the Adept biomes at two marks.

spawns.name: Oryx Wood Totem
spawns.note: Harmless; they take more damage from water balloons and Heatwave reskinned weapons.

events.name: Oryx Carnival
events.summary: A jester box opens on the realm's score.

spawns.name: Carnival Clown
spawns.where: Sprite Forest, Haunted Hallows, Coral Reefs
spawns.note: The page says the score is not known yet. He starts in a jester box.
